title: Warn at turn end when a routed reply names no principle or opens no playbook
action: D2. claims.rs holds unverified_agreement_warning(events), which reads the last turn's assistant text and returns an advisory warning; mod.rs adds it to the Stop output parts (line ~178, parts.extend(claims_warning)). Add beside it, in claims.rs, one function over the same last-turn events that returns zero, one or two warnings: (a) the turn holds a Bash tool call whose command runs 'bee orient' with '--class' and whose tool result lists principles (a line containing 'Principles (class='), and the final assistant text contains no 'bee-principle-' and no plain no-principle statement (English 'no principle' or Vietnamese 'không principle'/'không có principle', case-insensitive) — warn naming rule agents-name-applied-principles; (b) that orient result listed at least one 'situation:' line and the turn has no Read tool call (or Bash cat/sed/head of a path) whose path contains '/playbooks/' — warn that orient named a situation file and the turn never opened it. Walk the events the way last_turn_assistant_text does (stop at is_turn_boundary) and read both Claude 'assistant'/'user' tool_use/tool_result blocks and Codex response_item function_call/function_call_output, as collect_assistant_text does for text. Wire it into mod.rs next to claims_warning, on Stop only, advisory only — never a block. Unit tests in session_close/tests.rs for both warnings and their quiet cases. Sync the Stop part of docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/overview.md citing orient-host-playbook D2. One commit. Bee commands you may run: bee knowledge check. Run no dispatch verb, not even its help.

truths: a Stop after a turn that ran bee orient --class with principles and whose reply names no bee-principle- slug and no no-principle statement prints the principle warning
a reply that names a bee-principle- slug, or says no principle changed anything, prints no principle warning
a turn whose orient output listed a situation and that read no playbooks/ file prints the playbook warning
a turn without bee orient --class prints neither warning
neither warning ever blocks the Stop
key_links: mod.rs adds claims warnings to the Stop parts only on the Done path
is_turn_boundary marks where the last turn starts
prohibitions: No block or exit-code change in the Stop hook
